evidence.excerpt: CLASSLAB addressed the gap between classification algorithm research and practical laboratory deployment by developing a modular software toolkit for cost-sensitive threshold optimisation and model calibration. The project collected retrospective laboratory datasets from three hospitals in Vojvodina under data-sharing agreements and used them to benchmark methods across a range of imbalance ratios and cost structures. A secondary objective was to develop standardised protocols for eliciting misclassification cost estimates from clinical staff. The toolkit was implemented in Python and released as open-source software. The project supported two doctoral students and produced seven peer-reviewed publications. User testing with laboratory informaticians at the partner hospitals informed two revision cycles of the software interface.
